Location booking settings and configuration

Get location booking settings

GET
https://common-api.karma.life
/api/v1/locations/{locationId}/booking-settings

Get booking settings for a location. Creates default settings if none exist.

Permissions: 🔵 bookings.read

Get location booking settings › path Parameters

locationId
​number · required

Location ID

Get location booking settings › Responses

Default Response

status
​string · enum · required
Enum values:
success
​object · required
​object · required
GET/api/v1/locations/{locationId}/booking-settings
curl --request GET \ --url https://common-api.karma.life/api/v1/locations/:locationId/booking-settings
Example Responses

Update location booking settings

PUT
https://common-api.karma.life
/api/v1/locations/{locationId}/booking-settings

Update booking settings for a location.

Permissions: ⚪ bookings.manage

Update location booking settings › path Parameters

locationId
​number · required

Location ID

Update location booking settings › Request Body

bufferMinutes
​number · min: 0 · max: 120

Time buffer between bookings (minutes)

defaultDurationMinutes
​number · min: 15 · max: 480

Default booking duration (minutes)

autoOptimizeEnabled
​boolean

Enable automatic table optimization

maxPartySize
​number · min: 1 · max: 100

Maximum party size allowed

minAdvanceHours
​number · min: 0 · max: 168

Minimum hours in advance

maxAdvanceDays
​number · min: 1 · max: 365

Maximum days in advance

allowedPartySizes
​number[]

Specific party sizes allowed

operatingHours
​object

Per-day booking hours override

slotIntervalMinutes
​number · enum

Time slot interval (minutes)

Enum values:
15
30
45
60
90
overbookingBufferPercentage
​number · min: 0 · max: 50

Overbooking buffer percentage

confirmationMode
​string · enum

Booking confirmation mode

Enum values:
instant
request_based
autoNoShowDelayMinutes
​number | null · min: 5 · max: 120

Auto no-show delay (minutes)

cancellationPolicyHours
​number | null · min: 0 · max: 168

Cancellation policy (hours before)

bookingWindowDays
​number | null · min: 1 · max: 365

Booking window (days ahead)

maxActiveBookingsPerGuest
​number | null · min: 1 · max: 50

Max active bookings per guest

Update location booking settings › Responses

Default Response

status
​string · enum · required
Enum values:
success
​object · required
​object · required
PUT/api/v1/locations/{locationId}/booking-settings
